title: Close the 4 pre-existing data-coverage gaps in `internal/migrate/` so `oca migrate from-open-chad` produces a stack that passes `oca debug validate` against the operator's live state — final cutover-blocker for v1.0 / safe open-chad replacement.

Add RED test in `internal/migrate/openchad_test.go` (or `emit_test.go`) with a real Vision YAML fixture containing `base_port`/`count`/`group_port`/`template`. Expect cfg.Load to succeed AND each slot group to round-trip with correct base_port/count. GREEN: drop `MinSlots`/`MaxSlots` from `SlotGroupState` (lines 158-163) and the inline yaml struct (lines 430-436); add `BasePort int` / `Count int` with `yaml:"base_port"`/`yaml:"count"` tags; update emit (`emit.go:114-130`) to write `base_port = N` and `count = N`; skip empty `servers` array. Update any existing golden tests that asserted the old fields.
tasks.verification: Gap 3: `SlotGroupState` MinSlots/MaxSlots → BasePort/Count. `readVisionServers` inline yaml struct retagged to base_port/count. emit.go emits base_port/count instead of min_slots/max_slots. New `TestReadVisionServers_SlotGroupSchemaAlignment` exercises real Vision YAML shape with 2 playwright slot groups (headless: 6301/4, headed: 6306/2) and asserts BasePort/Count/GroupPort/Template round-trip correctly. All migrate package tests pass.

tasks.title: Gap 1 (MCP type translation): Inline TDD. Add `translateMCPType(t, url string) (translated, warning string)` + `portFromURL(rawURL string) int` helpers in `internal/migrate/openchad.go`. Matrix test cases per design.md: `remote + .../mcp` → `http`; `remote + non-/mcp URL` → `sse`; `remote + no URL` → `""` with warning; `stdio|http|sse|daemon` → passthrough; unknown → unchanged with warning. Wire into `readOpenCodeJSON` MCP loop (after reading type/url). Add post-read fix-up loop in `ReadOpenChadState` to fill `mcs.Port` from URL when still 0 after Vision read. Integration test: fixture with operator-shape opencode.json (6 remote servers with mixed /mcp suffix) produces a state where each server has the correct translated type + port.
tasks.verification: Gap 1: translateMCPType (URL-suffix-aware mirror of inferTransport at validate.go:474-491) + portFromURL helpers added to openchad.go. Wired into readOpenCodeJSON MCP loop with warning capture. Post-read fix-up at end of ReadOpenChadState fills Port from URL when Vision YAML didn't provide one. 11 translation subtests (5 mapping cases + 4 passthrough + edge cases) + 7 portFromURL cases + integration test against operator-shape fixture (5 → http, 1 → sse). Full migrate package green.

tasks.title: Gap 2 (plugin source fallback): Inline TDD. Add `fallbackResolvePluginSources(state)` + `expandTilde(p string) string` helpers in `internal/migrate/openchad.go`. Logic per design.md: for plugins with empty Source and non-empty Checkout, expand tilde to absolute; if `<abs>/.git` exists → readGitRemoteURL → Source; else → `source = "local:<abs>"` and clear Checkout. Wire into `ReadOpenChadState` immediately after `discoverPlugins`. Unit tests: (a) git-existence path resolves to remote URL; (b) non-git path → local: source; (c) tilde expansion correctness for `~/foo`, `~`, `/abs` (no-op), `relative` (no-op).
tasks.verification: Gap 2: fallbackResolvePluginSources + expandTilde helpers added. Wired into ReadOpenChadState as step 3b after discoverPlugins. Logic: empty Source + non-empty Checkout → tilde-expand to abs → if .git exists use git URL + preserve Checkout + capture Ref via readGitHEAD; else set source="local:<abs>" and clear Checkout. 4 tests pass: TestExpandTilde (7 cases including ~user passthrough), TestFallbackResolvePluginSources_LocalFallback (no .git), TestFallbackResolvePluginSources_GitDiscovery (with .git/config), TestFallbackResolvePluginSources_LeavesEnriched (existing source/npm untouched). Build fix: readGitRemoteURL/readGitHEAD return (string, error) — used proper two-return form.

tasks.title: Gap 4 (plugin name from /plugin suffix): Inline TDD. Refine `classifyPluginEntry` path branch per design.md: when `filepath.Base(entry) == "plugin"`, use `filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(entry))` as Name instead. Defensive: skip if parent is "" or "." or "/". Unit tests: `/x/foo/plugin` → name=`foo`; `/x/foo` → name=`foo`; `/x/foo/bar.js` → name=`bar.js`; `/plugin` (root-level) → name unchanged. Integration test: fixture with two entries `/x/foo/plugin` and `/x/bar/plugin` produces 2 plugins named `foo` and `bar` (no `[plugins.plugin]` collision).
tasks.verification: Gap 4: classifyPluginEntry path branch detects `<X>/<name>/plugin` convention via filepath.Base==`plugin` check; uses parent dir as Name when valid; defensive against root/empty/dot parents. New `TestClassifyPluginEntry_PluginSuffixNameDerivation` (5 cases) + `TestClassifyPluginEntry_NoCollisionAcrossPluginPaths`. Updated 2 pre-existing TestClassifyPluginEntry subtest assertions: `absolute path` / `tilde path` (now expect parent-dir-derived names per Gap 4 semantics) + added `absolute path without /plugin suffix` to lock the non-suffix path through basename. Full migrate package green.

tasks.title: Acceptance smoke test: Build fresh `oca` binary from current source. Run `oca migrate from-open-chad --output /tmp/oca-cutover-v2.toml` against the operator's actual `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` + `~/.config/vision/servers.yaml`. Run `oca debug validate --config /tmp/oca-cutover-v2.toml` — must return exit 0 with `ok` output. Capture the count of plugins, MCP servers, slot groups in the output as evidence. If any validation errors remain, do NOT expand scope — diagnose, fix within the 4-gap surface, re-run.
tasks.verification: Acceptance gate met. `oca migrate from-open-chad` against operator's live state produces `/tmp/oca-cutover-final.toml`; `oca debug validate` returns `ok` (0 errors, was 18 pre-change). Output: 16 MCP servers + 3 slot groups + 11 plugins, all with required fields. 1 server (gh_grep external HTTPS) skipped with explicit warning per emit policy. Iteration cycle within 4-gap surface: surfaced 3 sub-issues during smoke test (missing URL emit, transport-field conflict between opencode.json and Vision YAML, schema port-range constraint on external services), all fixed inside migrator boundary without expanding to schema/apply. Full `go test ./...` + `go vet` + `gofmt` clean. Wisdom `ws-_____` captures the multi-source-conflict learning for the migrate domain.

wisdom.content: Live smoke test surfaced two scope items not in the original 4-gap design that had to be solved within the change to reach the 0-errors acceptance gate: (1) URL field was never emitted by emit.go — pre-fix this masked itself because validation didn't run cleanly; once Gap 1 produced valid types the missing URL emit surfaced; fix: add `url = %q` emission. (2) Multi-source state conflict — opencode.json declares user intent (type+url for remote) while vision/servers.yaml declares Vision's local proxy impl (command+args for stdio). Both were copied to state, producing schema-invalid `cannot specify both command and url`. Fix: `normalizeTransportFields` post-read pass drops Command/Args for http/sse types and drops URL for stdio/daemon types. Also discovered OCA schema forces port ∈ [6275, 6325] for all MCP servers — external services like https://mcp.grep.app can't fit; emit-time skip-with-warning is the correct compromise (operator hand-adds post-migrate). These three sub-fixes belonged in scope because they were entirely inside the migrator surface and necessary to reach the acceptance criterion.
